rules.exact_source_text: We serve customers, not clients. Always address our platform users as customers or community members.

rules.description: Avoid aggressive urgency, clickbait and artificial pressure such as 'hurry up' or 'or regret it'.
rules.banned_pattern: \bhurry up\b|\bdon't miss out\b|\bor regret it\b|\bact fast or lose\b
rules.exact_source_text: Urgency should be respectful and informative. Never pressure users through manufactured panic, aggressive FOMO, or sensationalist threats.

rules.description: Claims of being '#1', 'the best in the world', or 'guaranteed returns' require official certified legal approval.
rules.exact_source_text: No content may claim '#1 in India' or 'guaranteed' returns without certified audited proof attached.

rules.description: All embedded visual banners and figures must provide descriptive alt-text.
rules.exact_source_text: All non-text visual content published across web and email channels must include concise, accurate text alternatives.
